documents.name: Corkboard
documents.description: A board on which notes, groups, links and cards showing views and widgets are laid out freely. It belongs to a user, an assignment or a story. A user can have several, each named by its title.

links.name: Personal board owner
links.description: The user a personal board belongs to, named by the subject of their login.

links.name: Assignment board owner
links.description: The assignment the board belongs to, named by the id of its block in the planning item that holds it. The planning item is not recorded: an assignment can be moved to another.

links.name: Story board owner
links.description: The story the board belongs to.

block.name: Note
block.description: A note of formatted text: its paragraphs are the text blocks in its content.

author.name: Author name
author.description: The display name of whoever wrote the note.

author_sub.name: Author subject
author_sub.description: The subject of whoever wrote the note.

block.name: Group
block.description: A named frame that carries the items lying in it.

block.name: Link
block.description: A link to a web address.

block.name: Card
block.description: A card about one thing, a document, a part of one, an object outside the documents or a value, shown as its full view or as its widget. It names its thing by reference and keeps no title of it.

w.description: The width of the card as a view.

h.description: The height of the card as a view.

widget_w.description: The width of the card as a widget.

widget_h.description: The height of the card as a widget.

presentation.description: Which of the two the card shows: its widget, or its view, which an empty value also means.

view.description: The view as the application encodes it: its id, handler, intent and parameters.

widget.description: The widget as the application encodes it: its id, handler, the intent carrying the reference or value it shows, stored state and least size.

follows.description: The id of the card this one is attached to: the view to its left in a row, or the widget it is attached beneath.

attached_as.description: The key a widget attached this card under.

hidden.description: Set while the widget this card is attached to hides it.

block.name: Reminder
block.description: A reminder on an item: one for everyone on the board, or one of a person's own, which only they are shown. An item holds at most one for everyone and one for each person.

for.description: Who the reminder is for: whoever set it, or everyone on the board.

by.description: The subject of whoever set it: the one it is for, or the last to set one for everyone.
